detail.longDescription: When personal automation becomes organizational infrastructure Carlos Robledo is a Lead Technical Sourcer at Hims & Hers. When he got tired of spending hours every Friday building hiring reports for stakeholders, he built Rex, a 19-workflow system that now serves recruiters across the talent organization.
